name: Steam Prison -Beyond the Steam-
original_name: スチームプリズン -Beyond the Steam-
source:
This story takes place two years after the "Grand Ending" from the original Steam Prison. While riding the "buggy" invented by the engineer (and information broker) Ulrik, our party arrives in the new land of Cainabel, where they meet a pair of kings. The story unfolds from there.

The stories of Ulrik, Adage, and Fin take place alongside the younger king Jevite in this strange land. Meanwhile Eltcreed, Ines, and Yune clear the way to Cainabel's future with the elder king Jereme.

This release also includes an additional story titled A New Theory.

In A New Theory, our heroine must confront the injustice of her world. She makes contact with the HOUNDS in order to clear her name, and decides to forge a new path for herself...

[b]Cainabel Story[/b]
Two years have passed since the unification of the Depths and the Heights, and the creation of a new government.

With those in the Heights now free to choose their own romantic partners, our heroine spends her days ducking meetings with potential suitors arranged by her mother. One such day, our heroine takes on a new mission. Joining an expedition tasked with investigating what lies beyond the fog encircling the Depths, she embarks on a journey into the unknown along with Fin, Ulrik, and Adage...

A brand-new world unlike the Heights or the Depths—Cainabel. Through fresh encounters and exposure to different values, our heroine, still a stranger to love, will build new relationships with her companions. Strange experiences and encounters in a foreign land.

Before long, changes begin to appear in their relationship as well...

[b]A New Theory[/b]
The Heights, a beautiful utopia in the sky, and the Depths, a filthy mechanical city. Those living in the Heights have immense power, and despise the Depths. Born and raised in the Heights herself, our heroine never had much fondness for them. But after being ordered on a mission to observe the Depths, she finds herself caught up in a cruel twist of fate.

Framed for the murder of her parents, our heroine is sentenced to the Depths, where Sachsen, leader of the HOUNDS, has been waiting...

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3003020]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这个故事发生在原版《蒸汽监狱》的“大结局”两年后。当我们乘坐工程师（兼信息经纪人）乌尔里克发明的“越野车”时，我们到达了新大陆卡纳贝尔，在那里他们遇到了一对国王。故事由此展开。

乌尔里克、阿达奇和芬的故事发生在这片陌生的土地上，与年轻的国王杰维特一起。与此同时，埃尔特克里德、伊内斯和尤恩为凯纳贝尔与年长的国王杰雷姆的未来扫清了道路。

此版本还包括一个名为“新理论”的附加故事。

在《新理论》中，我们的女主人公必须面对她世界的不公正。为了洗清自己的罪名，她与猎犬们进行了接触，并决定为自己开辟一条新的道路……

[b]卡纳贝尔的故事[/b]
自深地与高地统一以及新政府成立以来，已经过去了两年。

现在，高地的人们可以自由选择自己的浪漫伴侣，我们的女主人公整天都在躲避与母亲安排的潜在追求者的会面。有一天，我们的女主人公承担了一项新使命。她加入了一支探险队，任务是调查环绕深渊的迷雾之外隐藏着什么，她与芬、乌尔里克和阿迪奇一起踏上了未知的旅程……

不同于高地或深渊的全新世界——卡纳贝尔。通过新鲜的遭遇和接触不同的价值观，我们的女主人公，仍然对爱情陌生，将与她的同伴建立新的关系。在异国他乡的奇异经历和遭遇。

不久之后，他们的关系也开始出现变化……

[b]新理论[/b]
高地，美丽的空中乌托邦，深渊，肮脏的机械城市。住在高处的人拥有巨大的力量，而蔑视深处。我们的女主角本人在高地出生和长大，但她对他们从来没有太多的喜爱。但在受命执行观察深渊的任务后，她发现自己陷入了命运的残酷扭曲。

我们的女主角因谋杀父母而被陷害，被判入深渊，而猎犬首领萨克森一直在那里等待……
